name: mofa-notebook-source
description: Normalize workspace files into NotebookLM-like source manifests and chunks for source-grounded Octos chat.

tools.name: source_import
tools.description: Import a workspace-relative file as a notebook source. Creates notebook-sources/<source_id>/source.md, metadata.json, chunks.jsonl, and updates notebook-sources/manifest.json.

workspace.description: Workspace root. Defaults to current directory.

path.description: Workspace-relative source path, for example uploads/report.md.

tools.name: source_normalize
tools.description: Rebuild chunks and metadata for an existing notebook source id after source.md was edited.

workspace.description: Workspace root. Defaults to current directory.

tools.name: source_manifest
tools.description: Return the current notebook source manifest and source count.

workspace.description: Workspace root. Defaults to current directory.
